items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...But Roberts. You think it was Mac Robertson? ... [INTERVIEWEE] it was Mac Robertson because- Or Robinson or Robertson? Robinson. Robinson.

ctx.x: Yes, yes. And the drummer was Little Mac, Mud Carey on the trumpet. What was his last name? Do you remember? I think his last name was Robinson, but did we call him? Robinson. Yes. Little Mac

Robinson. There was once a Mac Murray there. Yeah. And then I've heard of a Mac Hill that Lee Collins has told me about. It wouldn't be Mac Hill. Oh, no, no, no, no. I didn't know any of those fellas myself, personally. Well, they all were kids. But Roberts. You think it was Mac Robertson? I think
it was Mac Robertson because- Or Robinson or Robertson? Robinson. Robinson.
